text:
If possible, I would rate Dr. Tanyathorn Teeranoraseth higher than 5 stars. I had been unable to smell and taste for more than a year due to benign polyps in my nasal cavity. Dr. Tanyathorn saw me on short notice, CT scans confirmed the presence of the polyps, and she led the surgical team that removed the polyps. What should have been a 1-2 hour surgery took over 5 hours because Dr. Tanyathorn discovered numerous additional polyps in my sinus cavities. She expertly removed all the polyps, and also fixed my deviated septum. Over the following three weeks, I had three follow-up appointments with Dr. Tanyathorn. She answered my questions (in excellent English), explained to me approximate timelines for recovery, and carefully removed scabs, clots, and fibrin. I felt slightly embarrassed to see some of the stuff Dr. Tanyathorn was pulling out of my nasal passages, but she just said, “It’s okay, it’s my job!”

To say I feel relief would be an understatement. My nasal passages feel clearer than they ever have, and I’m so grateful to Dr. Tanyathorn for helping improve my quality of life. She explained that the first month would be the toughest, and I’m at three weeks post-op today.  I started to regain my senses of smell/taste a few nights ago, and while not 100% yet, it’s better than the 0% I’ve had for the last year. I had my last follow up appointment with Dr. Tanyathorn, then went to the Saturday Walking Street. I felt like I was being led by my nose: meats grilling, waffles baking, durian on display, incense burning, perfume … After not being able to smell for a year, I felt overjoyed to remember what it was like.

If you are suffering from any ENT (ear/nose/throat) issue(s), especially sinus, I would highly recommend Dr. Tanyathorn without hesitation. She is kind, professional, communicative, and a subject matter expert in sinus-related issues. Thank you for massively improving my life, Dr. Tanyathorn!  Khup khun mach, khup! 🙂

text:
When you’re in a foreign country and something bad happens - things can get scary very quickly. So if you’re in Chiang Mai with a ENT issue… This is your place.

My partner and I came here on holiday when we had a freak accident during an underwater activity in Pattaya. My partner’s ears were compromised and we were absolutely shook.

Dr. Chaiwat answered the phone a little before opening hours and let us know that we could walk-in. His patience, understanding and generosity to carefully listen and help a frantic Korean couple (us) meant a lot! Of course, his expertise and communication skills in not only diagnosing but meticulously explaining why and what has happened was truly impressive and appreciated.

My partner’s ears were bloody from ear barotrauma due to a sudden change in pressure. Thereafter, we left with solutions and hope for recovery with appropriate medicine and medical advice. On the taxi back to our hotel, my partner and I discussed how not even in Australia nor South Korea could you find such a doctor who would hear out all of your questions and thoroughly answer them with a such a sincere heart. He is truly leading and outshining the new generation of healthcare professionals in Thailand + yonder.

Thank you again Doctor and we wish you all the best!
